name: gcs
title: Google Cloud Storage
description: Objects from a GCS bucket, downloaded and indexed. Needs a Google connection.

bucket.label: Bucket
bucket.hint: Pick from the buckets in the project below, or type the name (the gs:// prefix is optional). This names WHICH remote account the source serves.

project.label: GCP project
project.hint: Only needed to LIST buckets — a bucket you name yourself syncs without it. Google has no way to enumerate buckets except within one project.

prefixes.label: Prefixes
prefixes.hint: One per line. Leave empty for the whole bucket. GCS has no directories — a prefix is a query, and each gets its own cursor, so keep them non-overlapping or the objects under both are enumerated twice.

cache_root.label: Cache folder
cache_root.hint: Where downloaded bytes land. Defaults to this instance's own directory.
